As the one can commonly afford his work a good deal cheaper, so the other can commonly afford his goods somewhat cheaper, than if his stock and attention were both employed about a greater variety of objects. The greater part of manufacturers could not afford to retail their own goods so cheap as a vigilant and active shopkeeper, whose sole business it was to buy them by wholesale and to retail them again. The greater part of farmers could still less afford to retail their own corn, to supply the inhabitants of a town, at perhaps four or five miles distance from the greater part of them, so cheap as a vigilant and active corn merchant, whose sole business it was to purchase corn by wholesale, to collect it into a great magazine, and to retail it again.
p55.zh: 能够将全部股票用于单一业务的经销商与能够将全部劳动力用于单一业务的工人具有同样的优势。 由于后者获得了一种精巧的手法,使他能够用同样的两只手从事更多的工作,所以前者获得了一种交易他的业务、购买和处置他的货物的简单和成熟的方法,从而能够用同样的资本进行数量大得多的业务。 由于他的工作通常可以便宜一些,所以他的工作通常可以便宜一些,比起他的库存和注意力都用于更多种类的物品,他的产品通常可以便宜一些。大部分的制造商无法以警觉和活跃的店主的身份零售自己的商品,而店主的唯一业务是批发购买,然后再次零售。大部分的农民仍然负担不起自己的玉米零售,供应一个镇上的居民,可能离他们大部有四五英里远,所以作为警惕和活跃的玉米商人,价格低廉,唯一的生意就是通过批发购买玉米,把玉米收集到一个伟大的杂志上,然后再次零售.

p56.original: The law which prohibited the manufacturer from exercising the trade of a shopkeeper, endeavoured to force this division in the employment of stock to go on faster than it might otherwise have done. The law which obliged the farmer to exercise the trade of a corn merchant, endeavoured to hinder it from going on so fast. Both laws were evident violations of natural liberty, and therefore unjust; and they were both, too, as impolitic as they were unjust. It is the interest of every society, that things of this kind should never either he forced or obstructed. The man who employs either his labour or his stock in a greater variety of ways than his situation renders necessary, can never hurt his neighbour by underselling him. He may hurt himself, and he generally does so. Jack-of-all-trades will never be rich, says the proverb. But the law ought always to trust people with the care of their own interest, as in their local situations they must generally be able to judge better of it than the legislature can do. The law, however, which obliged the farmer to exercise the trade of a corn merchant was by far the most pernicious of the two.
p56.zh: 禁止制造商从事店主交易的法律试图迫使这一部门在使用股票方面比本来可以做到的更快。要求农民从事玉米商贸易的法律试图阻止这种交易如此迅速进行。这两项法律显然侵犯了自然自由,因此是不公正的;而且两者都与不公正一样无礼。 他不应该强迫或阻挠这种事情,这是每个社会的利益所在。以比他的情况更必要的方式雇用他的劳力或股票的人,绝对不能通过出卖他而伤害他的邻居。 他可能会伤害自己,他一般会这样。一句谚语说, "万行业的杰克"永远也不会发财。 但是,法律应该始终信任人们,照顾他们自己的利益,因为他们在当地的情况中,他们一般必须能够比立法机构能够做的更好判断法律。 然而,规定农民必须从事玉米商贸易的法律是迄今为止两者中最有害的法律。

p57.original: It obstructed not only that division in the employment of stock which is so advantageous to every society, but it obstructed likewise the improvement and cultivation of the land. By obliging the farmer to carry on two trades instead of one, it forced him to divide his capital into two parts, of which one only could be employed in cultivation. But if he had been at liberty to sell his whole crop to a corn merchant as fast as he could thresh it out, his whole capital might have returned immediately to the land, and have been employed in buying more cattle, and hiring more servants, in order to improve and cultivate it better. But by being obliged to sell his corn by retail, he was obliged to keep a great part of his capital in his granaries and stack-yard through the year, and could not therefore cultivate so well as with the same capital he might otherwise have done. This law, therefore, necessarily obstructed the improvement of the land, and, instead of tending to render corn cheaper, must have tended to render it scarcer, and therefore dearer, than it would otherwise have been.
p57.zh: 它不仅阻碍了对每个社会都如此有利的种群的利用,而且同样阻碍了土地的改良和耕种。迫使农民从事两个行业而不是一个,迫使他将其资本分成两个部分,其中只有一个只能用于种植。 但如果他能尽速地将整个作物卖给一个玉米商,那么他的全部资本可能立即回到了这片土地上,并受雇于购买更多的牛,雇用更多的仆人,以便改善和培育它。 但是,由于被迫通过零售出售他的玉米,他不得不将大部分资本留在他的粮仓和堆栈厂里,因此,他无法这样种植,也无法用他本来可以做的同样的资本来耕种。 因此,这项法律必然阻碍土地的改善,而且,它不是倾向于使玉米更便宜,而是倾向于使其更加稀少,因此比本来会更加贫乏。

p58.original: After the business of the farmer, that of the corn merchant is in reality the trade which, if properly protected and encouraged, would contribute the most to the raising of corn. It would support the trade of the farmer, in the same manner as the trade of the wholesale dealer supports that of the manufacturer.
p58.zh: 农民经商后,玉米商的生意实际上是贸易,如果得到适当的保护和鼓励,对玉米的种植贡献最大。它将支持农民的贸易,其方式与批发商的贸易支持制造商的贸易方式相同。

p59.original: The wholesale dealer, by affording a ready market to the manufacturer, by taking his goods off his hand as fast as he can make them, and by sometimes even advancing their price to him before he has made them, enables him to keep his whole capital, and sometimes even more than his whole capital, constantly employed in manufacturing, and consequently to manufacture a much greater quantity of goods than if he was obliged to dispose of them himself to the immediate consumers, or even to the retailers. As the capital of the wholesale merchant, too, is generally sufficient to replace that of many manufacturers, this intercourse between him and them interests the owner of a large capital to support the owners of a great number of small ones, and to assist them in those losses and misfortunes which might otherwise prove ruinous to them.
p59.zh: 批发商通过向制造商提供现成的市场,通过尽快将自己的商品从他手中拿走,甚至有时在自己制造之前就将商品的价格提高给他,使他能够保住自己的全部资本,有时甚至超过他的全部资本,经常从事制造业,从而制造出比被迫自己向直接消费者,甚至零售商处置更多的商品。 由于批发商的资本一般也足以取代许多制造商的资本,因此他和这些制造商之间的这种交往有利于一个大资本的所有人,以支持许多小资本的所有人,并帮助他们应付本来可能给他们造成破坏的损失和不幸。

p60.original: An intercourse of the same kind universally established between the farmers and the corn merchants, would be attended with effects equally beneficial to the farmers. They would be enabled to keep their whole capitals, and even more than their whole capitals constantly employed in cultivation. In case of any of those accidents to which no trade is more liable than theirs, they would find in their ordinary customer, the wealthy corn merchant, a person who had both an interest to support them, and the ability to do it; and they would not, as at present, be entirely dependent upon the forbearance of their landlord, or the mercy of his steward. Were it possible, as perhaps it is not, to establish this intercourse universally, and all at once; were it possible to turn all at once the whole farming stock of the kingdom to its proper business, the cultivation of land, withdrawing it from every other employment into which any part of it may be at present diverted; and were it possible, in order to support and assist, upon occasion, the operations of this great stock, to provide all at once another stock almost equally great; it is not, perhaps, very easy to imagine how great, how extensive, and how sudden, would be the improvement which this change of circumstances would alone produce upon the whole face of the country.
p60.zh: 农民和玉米商之间普遍建立的那种性交,将同样有利于农民。 他们将能够保持其全部首都,甚至比其全部首都更能够不断从事种植业。 如果发生任何一种事故,而这种事故没有贸易比其贸易更应负责,那么,他们就会在普通顾客、富人的玉米商身上找到一个既有利益又有能力支持他们的人;他们不会像目前那样完全依赖房东的容忍,也不完全依赖其管理者的怜悯。 如果有可能,也许不是,普遍地、同时地建立这种性交关系;如果能够立即将王国的全部农耕资源全部转向其正当的经营、土地的耕种、从目前任何部分可能被转用的所有其他就业中撤出;为了有时支持和协助这一大股的经营,能否同时提供几乎同样巨大的所有种群;也许很难想象,仅凭这种环境变化就能够改善整个国家的情况,其规模有多大、范围有多大、程度多么突然。

p61.original: The statute of Edward VI. therefore, by prohibiting as much as possible any middle man from coming in between the grower and the consumer, endeavoured to annihilate a trade, of which the free exercise is not only the best palliative of the inconveniencies of a dearth, but the best preventive of that calamity; after the trade of the farmer, no trade contributing so much to the growing of corn as that of the corn merchant.
p61.zh: 因此,爱德华六世的章程尽可能禁止任何中产阶级进入种植者和消费者之间,从而竭力消灭一种贸易,这种自由活动不仅是减轻穷人不便的最好办法,而且是预防这种灾难的最佳办法;在农民进行贸易之后,没有一种贸易能象玉米商人那样对玉米种植作出如此大的贡献。

p62.original: The rigour of this law was afterwards softened by several subsequent statutes, which successively permitted the engrossing of corn when the price of wheat should not exceed 20s. and 24s. 32s. and 40s. the quarter. At last, by the 15th of Charles II. c.7, the engrossing or buying of corn, in order to sell it again, as long as the price of wheat did not exceed 48s. the quarter, and that of other grain in proportion, was declared lawful to all persons not being forestallers, that is, not selling again in the same market within three months. All the freedom which the trade of the inland corn dealer has ever yet enjoyed was bestowed upon it by this statute. The statute of the twelfth of the present king, which repeals almost all the other ancient laws against engrossers and forestallers, does not repeal the restrictions of this particular statute, which therefore still continue in force.
p62.zh: 这项法律的严谨性后来由于后来的几项法规而有所软化,在小麦价格不超过20和24时,这些法规相继允许玉米的充斥。32和40秒, 季度。到了查理二世c.7的15日,为了再次销售玉米,只要小麦的价格不超过48.季度,以及按比例计算的其他谷物的价格,宣布所有不是阻止者的人都是合法的,即三个月内不再在同一市场销售。内陆玉米经销商贸易迄今享有的所有自由都是由这一法规赋予的。现国王第十二世的法规废除了几乎所有其他反对聚众和先锋的古代法律,并没有废除这一特定法规的限制,因此这些限制仍然有效.

p63.original: This statute, however, authorises in some measure two very absurd popular prejudices.
p63.zh: 然而,这项法规在某种程度上认可了两种非常荒谬的公众偏见。

p64.original: First, It supposes, that when the price of wheat has risen so high as 48s. the quarter, and that of other grain in proportion, corn is likely to be so engrossed as to hurt the people. But, from what has been already said, it seems evident enough, that corn can at no price be so engrossed by the inland dealers as to hurt the people; and 48s. the quarter, besides, though it may be considered as a very high price, yet, in years of scarcity, it is a price which frequently takes place immediately after harvest, when scarce any part of the new crop can be sold off, and when it is impossible even for ignorance to suppose that any part of it can be so engrossed as to hurt the people.
p64.zh: 首先,它假设,当小麦的价格上升到48分之四,而其他谷物的价格则成比例地上升时,玉米很可能被挤满,以致伤害人民。 但是,从已经说过的话来看,似乎已经足够明显了,玉米不会被内陆经销商所吞噬而伤害人民;还有48s。 此外,虽然它可能被认为是非常高的价格,但在多年的匮乏中,它经常发生在收割之后,当新作物中任何部分的稀缺部分能够出售时,即使无知也不可能认为它的任何部分能够被吞噬而伤害人民。

p65.original: Secondly, It supposes that there is a certain price at which corn is likely to be forestalled, that is, bought up in order to be sold again soon after in the same market, so as to hurt the people. But if a merchant ever buys up corn, either going to a particular market, or in a particular market, in order to sell it again soon after in the same market, it must be because he judges that the market cannot be so liberally supplied through the whole season as upon that particular occasion, and that the price, therefore, must soon rise. If he judges wrong in this, and if the price does not rise, he not only loses the whole profit of the stock which he employs in this manner, but a part of the stock itself, by the expense and loss which necessarily attend the storing and keeping of corn. He hurts himself, therefore, much more essentially than he can hurt even the particular people whom he may hinder from supplying themselves upon that particular market day, because they may afterwards supply themselves just as cheap upon any other market day. If he judges right, instead of hurting the great body of the people, he renders them a most important service. By making them feel the inconveniencies of a dearth somewhat earlier than they otherwise might do, he prevents their feeling them afterwards so severely as they certainly would do, if the cheapness of price encouraged them to consume faster than suited the real scarcity of the season. When the scarcity is real, the best thing that can be done for the people is, to divide the inconvenience of it as equally as possible, through all the different months and weeks and days of the year. The interest of the corn merchant makes him study to do this as exactly as he can; and as no other person can have either the same interest, or the same knowledge, or the same abilities, to do it so exactly as he, this most important operation of commerce ought to be trusted entirely to him; or, in other words, the corn trade, so far at least as concerns the supply of the home market, ought to be left perfectly free.
p65.zh: 第二,它假设有一种价格,即购买玉米,以便不久后在同一市场再次出售,从而伤害人民。 但是,如果一个商人曾经购买玉米,或者去某个特定市场,或者在某个特定市场,以便在同一市场不久后再次出售,那一定是因为他判断,整个季节的市场不能像那个特定场合那样自由供应,因此价格必须很快上涨. 如果他判断错了,如果价格没有上涨,他不仅损失了他以这种方式使用的股票的全部利润,而且还损失了股票本身的一部分,其代价和损失必然涉及玉米的储存和保存。 因此,他伤害了自己,根本上连他可能阻碍在那个特定市场日供货的特定人都无法伤害,因为他们之后可能在任何其他市场日提供同样廉价的供货。 如果他判断正确,而不是伤害人民的身体,他使他们成为最重要的服务. 如果价格低廉鼓励他们消费的速度比本季真正稀缺的速度快,那么,他使他们觉得缺钱的不便比他们可能做的早一些,从而避免了他们事后的不便。 当稀缺是真实的时,对人民来说最好的办法就是,通过一年中所有不同的月份和周日,尽可能平等地分清其中的不便.玉米商的兴趣使他研究尽可能地做到这一点;由于没有其他人能够像他那样拥有同样的利益、同样的知识或同样的能力来做到这一点,这一最重要的商业业务应该完全相信他;或者换句话说,玉米贸易,至少就国内市场的供应而言,应该完全自由地进行。

p66.original: The popular fear of engrossing and forestalling may be compared to the popular terrors and suspicions of witchcraft. The unfortunate wretches accused of this latter crime were not more innocent of the misfortunes imputed to them, than those who have been accused of the former. The law which put an end to all prosecutions against witchcraft, which put it out of any man's power to gratify his own malice by accusing his neighbour of that imaginary crime, seems effectually to have put an end to those fears and suspicions, by taking away the great cause which encouraged and supported them. The law which would restore entire freedom to the inland trade of corn, would probably prove as effectual to put an end to the popular fears of engrossing and forestalling.
p66.zh: 大众对滋扰和阻止的恐惧可以和大众对巫术的恐怖和怀疑相提并论.被控后一罪行的不幸的手杖,与其说是那些被指控为前者的手杖,不如说是无辜的。法律终止了对巫术的一切起诉,它使任何男子都无权通过指控他的邻居犯下这种想象中的罪行来夸大自己的恶意,它实际上似乎已经消除了这些恐惧和怀疑,并夺走了鼓励和支持他们的伟大事业。恢复玉米内陆贸易全部自由的法律,很可能证明是有效的,可以消除大众对令人困扰和阻止的恐惧。

p67.original: The 15th of Charles II. c. 7, however, with all its imperfections, has, perhaps, contributed more, both to the plentiful supply of the home market, and to the increase of tillage, than any other law in the statute book. It is from this law that the inland corn trade has derived all the liberty and protection which it has ever yet enjoyed; and both the supply of the home market and the interest of tillage are much more effectually promoted by the inland, than either by the importation or exportation trade.
p67.zh: 15日 查尔斯二世 c.7,然而,由于种种不完善,也许对家庭市场供应充裕,以及耕作的增加都比法规书中任何其他法律都做出了更大的贡献.内陆玉米贸易正是从这项法律中获得了它迄今享有的所有自由和保护;而内陆地区比进出口贸易更能有效地促进国内市场的供应和耕作利益。

p68.original: The proportion of the average quantity of all sorts of grain imported into Great Britain to that of all sorts of grain consumed, it has been computed by the author of the Tracts upon the Corn Trade, does not exceed that of one to five hundred and seventy. For supplying the home market, therefore, the importance of the inland trade must be to that of the importation trade as five hundred and seventy to one.
p68.zh: 大不列颠进口的各类谷物平均数量与所消费的各类谷物平均数量的比例,由玉米贸易区作者计算得出,不超过1至570。 因此,对于国内市场的供应来说,内陆贸易对于进口贸易的重要性必须达到570比1。

p69.original: The average quantity of all sorts of grain exported from Great Britain does not, according to the same author, exceed the one-and-thirtieth part of the annual produce. For the encouragement of tillage, therefore, by providing a market for the home produce, the importance of the inland trade must be to that of the exportation trade as thirty to one.
p69.zh: 同一作者认为,从英国出口的各种谷物的平均数量不超过年度产量的1/30。 因此,为了鼓励耕作,通过为本国产品提供市场,内陆贸易对于出口贸易的重要性必须是三十至一。

p70.original: I have no great faith in political arithmetic, and I mean not to warrant the exactness of either of these computations. I mention them only in order to show of how much less consequence, in the opinion of the most judicious and experienced persons, the foreign trade of corn is than the home trade. The great cheapness of corn in the years immediately preceding the establishment of the bounty may, perhaps with reason, he ascribed in some measure to the operation of this statute of Charles II. which had been enacted about five-and-twenty years before, and which had, therefore, full time to produce its effect.
p70.zh: 我对政治算术不甚有信心,我无意为任何一种计算提供准确性。 我提到这些问题只是为了表明,在最明智和经验最丰富的人看来,玉米的对外贸易比国内贸易的后果要小得多。赏金建立之前的几年里,玉米价格非常低廉,也许有原因,他在某种程度上将这一查理二世的章程的操作归结为他,该章程是在大约5年和20年前颁布的,因此,有全时产生其效果。

p71.original: A very few words will sufficiently explain all that I have to say concerning the other three branches of the corn trade.
p71.zh: 极少数的话将充分解释我必须就玉米贸易其他三个分支说的所有话。

p72.original: II. The trade of the merchant-importer of foreign corn for home consumption, evidently contributes to the immediate supply of the home market, and must so far be immediately beneficial to the great body of the people. It tends, indeed, to lower somewhat the average money price of corn, but not to diminish its real value, or the quantity of labour which it is capable of maintaining. If importation was at all times free, our farmers and country gentlemen would probably, one year with another, get less money for their corn than they do at present, when importation is at most times in effect prohibited; but the money which they got would be of more value, would buy more goods of all other kinds, and would employ more labour. Their real wealth, their real revenue, therefore, would be the same as at present, though it might be expressed by a smaller quantity of silver, and they would neither be disabled nor discouraged from cultivating corn as much as they do at present. On the contrary, as the rise in the real value of silver, in consequence of lowering the money price of corn, lowers somewhat the money price of all other commodities, it gives the industry of the country where it takes place some advantage in all foreign markets and thereby tends to encourage and increase that industry. But the extent of the home market for corn must be in proportion to the general industry of the country where it grows, or to the number of those who produce something else, and therefore, have something else, or, what comes to the same thing, the price of something else, to give in exchange for corn. But in every country, the home market, as it is the nearest and most convenient, so is it likewise the greatest and most important market for corn. That rise in the real value of silver, therefore, which is the effect of lowering the average money price of corn, tends to enlarge the greatest and most important market for corn, and thereby to encourage, instead of discouraging its growth.
p72.zh: 二、导 言外国玉米的商贩——进口商为家庭消费而进行的贸易,显然有助于家庭市场的即时供应,而且必须使人民群众立即受益。 事实上,它往往会略微降低玉米的平均价格,但不会降低其实际价值或能够维持的劳动力数量。 如果进口在任何时候都是免费的,那么我们的农民和国家绅士们很可能一年一年地得到比现在少的钱买他们的玉米,而当时实际上多数时候是禁止进口的;但是他们得到的钱会更有价值,会购买更多的其他种类的货物,并且会雇用更多的劳动力. 因此,他们的实际财富、实际收入与目前相同,尽管可能用少量的白银来表示,他们不会像现在那样丧失能力,也不会劝阻他们种植玉米。 相反,由于白银的实际价值上升,由于玉米的货币价格降低,使所有其他商品的货币价格略低,因此,它使该国工业在所有外国市场中占有一定优势,从而往往鼓励和增加这一工业。 但玉米的家用市场范围必须与其种植地国家的一般工业成正比,或者与生产其他东西的人的数量成正比,因此,有其他东西,或者说,同一件事,其他东西的价格,以换取玉米. 但是,在每个国家,家庭市场,因为它是最近的和最方便的,同样也是玉米的最大和最重要的市场。 因此,白银的实际价值上升,是降低玉米平均货币价格的结果,往往会扩大玉米的最大和最重要的市场,从而鼓励而不是阻止其增长。

p73.original: By the 22d of Charles II. c. 13, the importation of wheat, whenever the price in the home market did not exceed 53s:4d. the quarter, was subjected to a duty of 16s. the quarter; and to a duty of 8s. whenever the price did not exceed £4. The former of these two prices has, for more than a century past, taken place only in times of very great scarcity; and the latter has, so far as I know, not taken place at all. Yet, till wheat has risen above this latter price, it was, by this statute, subjected to a very high duty; and, till it had risen above the former, to a duty which amounted to a prohibition. The importation of other sorts of grain was restrained at rates and by duties, in proportion to the value of the grain, almost equally high. Before the 13th of the present king, the following were the duties payable upon the importation of the different sorts of grain:

p75.original: These different duties were imposed, partly by the 22d of Charles II. in place of the old subsidy, partly by the new subsidy, by the one-third and two-thirds subsidy, and by the subsidy 1747. Subsequent laws still further increased those duties.
p75.zh: 这些不同的义务是由查理二世的22d代替旧的补贴、新的补贴、三分之一和三分之二的补贴以及1747年的补贴规定的。 随后的法律仍然进一步增加了这些义务。

p76.original: The distress which, in years of scarcity, the strict execution of those laws might have brought upon the people, would probably have been very great; but, upon such occasions, its execution was generally suspended by temporary statutes, which permitted, for a limited time, the importation of foreign corn. The necessity of these temporary statutes sufficiently demonstrates the impropriety of this general one.
p76.zh: 在匮乏的岁月里,这些法律的严格执行可能给人民带来极大痛苦,但在这种情况下,临时法规一般暂停执行,因为临时法规允许在有限的时间内进口外国玉米。 这些临时法规的必要性充分表明这一一般性法规的不当性。

p77.original: These restraints upon importation, though prior to the establishment of the bounty, were dictated by the same spirit, by the same principles, which afterwards enacted that regulation. How hurtful soever in themselves, these, or some other restraints upon importation, became necessary in consequence of that regulation. If, when wheat was either below 48s. the quarter, or not much above it, foreign corn could have been imported, either duty free, or upon paying only a small duty, it might have been exported again, with the benefit of the bounty, to the great loss of the public revenue, and to the entire perversion of the institution, of which the object was to extend the market for the home growth, not that for the growth of foreign countries.
p77.zh: 进口方面的这些限制,尽管是在设立赏金之前,也是本着同样的精神,根据同样的原则,随后又颁布了该条例。 由于这一条例,无论其本身、这些限制或进口时的一些其他限制多么有害。 如果,当小麦低于48岁,或者小麦的四分之一,或者小麦的四分之一,或者小麦的四分之一,外国玉米本来可以被免税进口,或者在只缴纳少量关税时,就可能再次被出口,在赏金的帮助下,又被出口到公共收入的巨大损失,并被整个机构扭曲,而其目的就是扩大国内增长的市场,而不是外国的增长.

p78.original: III. The trade of the merchant-exporter of corn for foreign consumption, certainly does not contribute directly to the plentiful supply of the home market. It does so, however, indirectly. From whatever source this supply maybe usually drawn, whether from home growth, or from foreign importation, unless more corn is either usually grown, or usually imported into the country, than what is usually consumed in it, the supply of the home market can never be very plentiful. But unless the surplus can, in all ordinary cases, be exported, the growers will be careful never to grow more, and the importers never to import more, than what the bare consumption of the home market requires. That market will very seldom be overstocked; but it will generally be understocked; the people, whose business it is to supply it, being generally afraid lest their goods should be left upon their hands. The prohibition of exportation limits the improvement and cultivation of the country to what the supply of its own inhabitants require. The freedom of exportation enables it to extend cultivation for the supply of foreign nations.
p78.zh: 三. 方案供外国消费的玉米的商家-出口商的贸易,当然不能直接促进国内市场的充裕供应。 然而,它间接地这样做。无论是从国内种植还是从国外进口,除非通常种植更多的玉米,或者通常进口到国内,无论这种供应来源如何,都可能通常来自国内,除非比国内通常消费的玉米多,否则国内市场的供应永远不可能非常充裕。 但除非盈余在一切普通情况下都可以出口,否则种植者将小心地永远不要增长,进口者永远不要进口,这是国内市场赤裸裸的消费所需要的. 这一市场很少被过度储存;但它一般是储存不足的;人民一般害怕自己的货物落入他们手中,而他们的业务是供应市场。禁止出口将改善和种植国家限制在满足本国居民供应需求的范围内。出口自由使它能够扩大种植,供外国供应。

p79.original: By the 12th of Charles II. c.4, the exportation of corn was permitted whenever the price of wheat did not exceed 40s. the quarter, and that of other grain in proportion. By the 15th of the same prince, this liberty was extended till the price of wheat exceeded 48s. the quarter; and by the 22d, to all higher prices. A poundage, indeed, was to be paid to the king upon such exportation; but all grain was rated so low in the book of rates, that this poundage amounted only, upon wheat to 1s., upon oats to 4d., and upon all other grain to 6d. the quarter. By the 1st of William and Mary, the act which established this bounty, this small duty was virtually taken off whenever the price of wheat did not exceed 48s. the quarter; and by the 11th and 12th of William III. c. 20, it was expressly taken off at all higher prices.
p79.zh: 到了Charles II.c.4第12天,只要小麦的价格不超过季度的40分之四,其他谷物的价格也按比例的比例允许出口玉米。到了同一位王子的15日,这种自由被延长至小麦的价格超过48%的季度;到22日,则扩大到所有更高的价格. 在出口时,确实要向国王支付一磅粮食;但是,所有谷物在税率表中都被评为如此低,以至于只有小麦1分,燕麦4分,所有其他谷物6分。到了威廉和玛丽的1日,确定这种赏金的行为,只要小麦的价格不超过48分之4,这个小义务就几乎被取消;到了威廉三世的11和12分之3,这个小义务被取消.20,它被明确 以更高的价格起飞。

p80.original: The trade of the merchant-exporter was, in this manner, not only encouraged by a bounty, but rendered much more free than that of the inland dealer. By the last of these statutes, corn could be engrossed at any price for exportation; but it could not be engrossed for inland sale, except when the price did not exceed 48s. the quarter. The interest of the inland dealer, however, it has already been shown, can never be opposite to that of the great body of the people. That of the merchant-exporter may, and in fact sometimes is. If, while his own country labours under a dearth, a neighbouring country should be afflicted with a famine, it might be his interest to carry corn to the latter country, in such quantities as might very much aggravate the calamities of the dearth. The plentiful supply of the home market was not the direct object of those statutes; but, under the pretence of encouraging agriculture, to raise the money price of corn as high as possible, and thereby to occasion, as much as possible, a constant dearth in the home market. By the discouragement of importation, the supply of that market; even in times of great scarcity, was confined to the home growth; and by the encouragement of exportation, when the price was so high as 48s. the quarter, that market was not, even in times of considerable scarcity, allowed to enjoy the whole of that growth. The temporary laws, prohibiting, for a limited time, the exportation of corn, and taking off, for a limited time, the duties upon its importation, expedients to which Great Britain has been obliged so frequently to have recourse, sufficiently demonstrate the impropriety of her general system. Had that system been good, she would not so frequently have been reduced to the necessity of departing from it.
p80.zh: 以这种方式,商人-出口商的贸易不仅受到赏金的鼓励,而且比内陆经销商的自由得多。 根据最后一项法规,玉米可以以任何出口价格充斥;但不能以内陆销售价格充斥,除非价格不超过季度48。 但是,已经表明,内陆经销商的兴趣永远不能与人民伟大身体的利益相悖。商家――出口商可以,而且事实上有时是。 如果在他自己的国家中,一个邻国在贫乏的状态下工作,却遭受饥荒,那么,他可能有兴趣将玉米运往贫乏的国家,其数量可能大大加重贫乏者的灾难。家庭市场的大量供应不是这些法规的直接目标;而是在鼓励农业的借口下,尽可能提高玉米的货币价格,从而在家庭市场中造成不断的匮乏。 由于进口的阻遏,该市场的供应,即使在极为稀缺的时期,也仅限于国内增长;由于出口的鼓励,当价格高达48多时,该季度的市场即使在相当匮乏的时期,也不能享受到这一增长的全部。暂时性法律在有限的时间内禁止出口玉米,并在有限的时间内取消进口玉米的义务,英国经常不得不求助于这些法律,充分表明其一般制度不适当。 如果这个制度好,她就不会经常被贬低为必须退出这个制度。

p81.original: Were all nations to follow the liberal system of free exportation and free importation, the different states into which a great continent was divided, would so far resemble the different provinces of a great empire. As among the different provinces of a great empire, the freedom of the inland trade appears, both from reason and experience, not only the best palliative of a dearth, but the most effectual preventive of a famine; so would the freedom of the exportation and importation trade be among the different states into which a great continent was divided. The larger the continent, the easier the communication through all the different parts of it, both by land and by water, the less would any one particular part of it ever be exposed to either of these calamities, the scarcity of any one country being more likely to be relieved by the plenty of some other. But very few countries have entirely adopted this liberal system. The freedom of the corn trade is almost everywhere more or less restrained, and in many countries is confined by such absurd regulations, as frequently aggravate the unavoidable misfortune of a dearth into the dreadful calamity of a famine. The demand of such countries for corn may frequently become so great and so urgent, that a small state in their neighbourhood, which happened at the same time to be labouring under some degree of dearth, could not venture to supply them without exposing itself to the like dreadful calamity. The very bad policy of one country may thus render it, in some measure, dangerous and imprudent to establish what would otherwise be the best policy in another. The unlimited freedom of exportation, however, would be much less dangerous in great states, in which the growth being much greater, the supply could seldom be much affected by any quantity or corn that was likely to be exported. In a Swiss canton, or in some of the little states in Italy, it may, perhaps, sometimes be necessary to restrain the exportation of corn. In such great countries as France or England, it scarce ever can. To hinder, besides, the farmer from sending his goods at all times to the best market, is evidently to sacrifice the ordinary laws of justice to an idea of public utility, to a sort of reasons of state; an act or legislative authority which ought to be exercised only, which can be pardoned only, in cases of the most urgent necessity. The price at which exportation of corn is prohibited, if it is ever to be prohibited, ought always to be a very high price.
p81.zh: 如果所有国家都遵循自由出口和自由进口的自由制度,那么,一个伟大的大陆被分割成不同的国家,迄今为止将类似于一个大帝国的不同省份。 作为大帝国的不同省份之一,从理性和经验上看,内陆贸易的自由不仅最能缓解匮乏者的痛苦,而且最能有效地预防饥荒;进出口贸易的自由,也是大大陆分裂成的不同国家之间的自由。非洲大陆越大,通过大陆所有不同部分,无论是通过陆地还是水路,交流越容易,其中任何一个特定部分遭受这些灾害的风险就越小,一个国家的稀缺性就越有可能被其他一些国家的丰富资源所缓解。 但很少有国家完全采用这种自由主义制度.玉米贸易的自由几乎在任何地方都受到多少的限制,在许多国家,这种荒谬的规定限制了这种自由,因为经常使穷人不可避免的不幸恶化,成为饥荒的可怕灾难。这些国家对玉米的需求可能常常变得如此巨大和紧迫,以致其邻近地区一个小国,同时在某种程度的匮乏下工作,无法冒昧地供应玉米,而不面临类似的可怕灾难。 因此,一国的非常糟糕的政策可能在某种程度上使制定另一国的最佳政策变得危险和不谨慎。 但是,在大国家,无限出口自由的危险要小得多,在大国家,增长要大得多,供应很少受到任何数量或可能出口的玉米的影响。 在瑞士的一个州,或者在意大利的一些小州,也许有时有必要限制玉米的出口。 在像法国或英国这样的伟大国家里,它很少能。 此外,为了阻止农民随时将货物送到最佳市场,显然要牺牲普通司法法,让公共事业观念成为某种国家理由;只能行使一项行为或立法权力,只有在最迫切的情况下才可赦免。禁止出口玉米的价格,如果说曾经被禁止的话,应该始终是很高的价格。

p82.original: The laws concerning corn may everywhere be compared to the laws concerning religion. The people feel themselves so much interested in what relates either to their subsistence in this life, or to their happiness in a life to come, that government must yield to their prejudices, and, in order to preserve the public tranquillity, establish that system which they approve of. It is upon this account, perhaps, that we so seldom find a reasonable system established with regard to either of those two capital objects.
p82.zh: 各地有关玉米的法律可以与宗教法律相比较。人民感到非常关心的是,政府必须屈服于他们的偏见,为了维护公众的安宁,建立他们赞同的制度,这既关系到他们的生活,也关系到他们未来生活的幸福。 或许正是出于这一原因,我们很少找到一个针对这两个资本对象中任何一个所建立的合理制度。

p83.original: IV. The trade of the merchant-carrier, or of the importer of foreign corn, in order to export it again, contributes to the plentiful supply of the home market. It is not, indeed, the direct purpose of his trade to sell his corn there; but he will generally be willing to do so, and even for a good deal less money than he might expect in a foreign market; because he saves in this manner the expense of loading and unloading, of freight and insurance. The inhabitants of the country which, by means of the carrying trade, becomes the magazine and storehouse for the supply of other countries, can very seldom be in want themselves. Though the carrying trade must thus contribute to reduce the average money price of corn in the home market, it would not thereby lower its real value; it would only raise somewhat the real value of silver.
p83.zh: 四. 联合国商贩或外国玉米进口商为了再次出口而进行贸易,有助于国内市场的充裕供应。 实际上,他在那里出售玉米并非其贸易的直接目的;但他一般愿意这样做,甚至比他预期的外国市场少很多钱;因为他这样节省了装卸、货运和保险的费用。 该国居民通过载货贸易成为供其他国家供应的杂志和仓库,他们本身很少会感到匮乏。 虽然承销贸易必须有助于降低玉米在国内市场的平均货币价格,但不会因此降低其实际价值;它只会增加一些银币的实际价值。

p84.original: The carrying trade was in effect prohibited in Great Britain, upon all ordinary occasions, by the high duties upon the importation of foreign corn, of the greater part of which there was no drawback; and upon extraordinary occasions, when a scarcity made it necessary to suspend those duties by temporary statutes, exportation was always prohibited. By this system of laws, therefore, the carrying trade was in effect prohibited.
p84.zh: 在大不列颠,由于进口外国玉米时征收高额关税,实际上禁止携带贸易,而进口大部分玉米时没有退步;在非常情况下,由于短缺,临时法规规定必须暂停这些关税,出口总是被禁止的。 因此,这一法律制度实际上禁止载货贸易。

p85.original: That system of laws, therefore, which is connected with the establishment of the bounty, seems to deserve no part of the praise which has been bestowed upon it. The improvement and prosperity of Great Britain, which has been so often ascribed to those laws, may very easily be accounted for by other causes. That security which the laws in Great Britain give to every man, that he shall enjoy the fruits of his own labour, is alone sufficient to make any country flourish, notwithstanding these and twenty other absurd regulations of commerce; and this security was perfected by the Revolution, much about the same time that the bounty was established. The natural effort of every individual to better his own condition, when suffered to exert itself with freedom and security, is so powerful a principle, that it is alone, and without any assistance, not only capable of carrying on the society to wealth and prosperity, but of surmounting a hundred impertinent obstructions, with which the folly of human laws too often encumbers its operations: though the effect of those obstructions is always, more or less, either to encroach upon its freedom, or to diminish its security. In Great Britain industry is perfectly secure; and though it is far from being perfectly free, it is as free or freer than in any other part of Europe.
p85.zh: 因此,这种法律制度与建立赏金有关,似乎不值得给予它应有的赞扬。 大不列颠的改善和繁荣常常被归咎于这些法律,但其他原因可能很容易成为其原因。 大不列颠法律赋予每个人的、他应享有自己劳动的成果的安全,就足以使任何国家繁荣起来,尽管有这些和另外20条荒谬的商业条例;这种安全是革命所完善的,这在很大程度上与赏金的建立同时。每个人在为自由和安全而受苦时,为改善自己状况所作的自然努力,是一项非常有力的原则,它既是唯一的,又没有任何援助,不仅能够使社会走向财富和繁荣,而且能够克服一百个不适当的障碍,而人类法的愚蠢往往会阻碍它的运作:尽管这些障碍的影响总是或多或少地侵犯它的自由,或削弱它的安全。 在大不列颠工业是完全安全的;虽然它远非完全自由,但它与欧洲任何其他地区一样自由或自由。

p86.original: Though the period of the greatest prosperity and improvement of Great Britain has been posterior to that system of laws which is connected with the bounty, we must not upon that account, impute it to those laws. It has been posterior likewise to the national debt; but the national debt has most assuredly not been the cause of it.
p86.zh: 虽然大不列颠最繁荣和进步的时期是同赏金有关的法律制度的后期,但我们决不能因此而把它归咎于这些法律。国家债务也是后遗症;但国家债务无疑不是其原因。

p87.original: Though the system of laws which is connected with the bounty, has exactly the same tendency with the practice of Spain and Portugal, to lower somewhat the value of the precious metals in the country where it takes place; yet Great Britain is certainly one of the richest countries in Europe, while Spain and Portugal are perhaps amongst the most beggarly. This difference of situation, however, may easily be accounted for from two different causes. First, the tax in Spain, the prohibition in Portugal of exporting gold and silver, and the vigilant police which watches over the execution of those laws, must, in two very poor countries, which between them import annually upwards of six millions sterling, operate not only more directly, but much more forcibly, in reducing the value of those metals there, than the corn laws can do in Great Britain. And, secondly, this bad policy is not in those countries counterbalanced by the general liberty and security of the people. Industry is there neither free nor secure; and the civil and ecclesiastical governments of both Spain and Portugal are such as would alone be sufficient to perpetuate their present state of poverty, even though their regulations of commerce were as wise as the greatest part of them are absurd and foolish.
p87.zh: 虽然与赏金有关的法律体系与西班牙和葡萄牙的做法完全相同,但从某种程度上降低贵重金属在其发生地国家的价值;但大不列颠无疑是欧洲最富有的国家之一,而西班牙和葡萄牙也许是最乞讨的国家之一。 然而,这种情况的差异可能很容易从两个不同的原因得到解释。 第一,西班牙的税收、葡萄牙禁止出口金银以及监督这些法律执行情况的警觉警察,必须在两个非常贫穷的国家中运作,它们之间每年进口600万英镑以上,不仅直接而且更强制地减少那里的金属价值,而大不列颠的玉米法则可以这样做。 第二,在这些国家,这种不良政策并没有被人民的一般自由和安全所抵消。工业既无自由,也无安全;西班牙和葡萄牙的民政和教会政府,即使其商业条例与它们中最大的部分一样明智,都荒唐和愚蠢,但仅靠它们本身就足以维持其目前的贫困状况。

p88.original: The 13th of the present king, c. 43, seems to have established a new system with regard to the corn laws, in many respects better than the ancient one, but in one or two respects perhaps not quite so good.
p88.zh: 现王十三世 c.43,似乎建立了玉米法的新制度,在许多方面比古法好,但在一两个方面也许并不那么好.

p89.original: By this statute, the high duties upon importation for home consumption are taken off, so soon as the price of middling wheat rises to 48s. the quarter; that of middling rye, pease, or beans, to 32s.; that of barley to 24s.; and that of oats to 16s.; and instead of them, a small duty is imposed of only 6d upon the quarter of wheat, and upon that or other grain in proportion. With regard to all those different sorts of grain, but particularly with regard to wheat, the home market is thus opened to foreign supplies, at prices considerably lower than before.
p89.zh: 根据这项法规,进口家庭消费的高额关税即告取消,一旦小麦的价格上涨至48.季度;小麦、小麦、小麦或豆的价格上涨至32.秒;大麦的上涨至24.秒;燕麦的上涨至16.秒;而不是在小麦的上涨至6d,以及按比例对小麦或其他谷物征收的小额关税。 关于所有这些不同种类的谷物,特别是小麦,国内市场因此向外国供应开放,其价格比以前低得多。

p90.original: By the same statute, the old bounty of 5s. upon the exportation of wheat, ceases so soon as the price rises to 44s. the quarter, instead of 48s. the price at which it ceased before; that of 2s:6d. upon the exportation of barley, ceases so soon as the price rises to 22s. instead of 24s. the price at which it ceased before; that of 2s:6d. upon the exportation of oatmeal, ceases so soon as the price rises to 14s. instead of 15s. the price at which it ceased before. The bounty upon rye is reduced from 3s:6d. to 3s. and it ceases so soon as the price rises to 28s. instead of 32s. the price at which it ceased before. If bounties are as improper as I have endeavoured to prove them to be, the sooner they cease, and the lower they are, so much the better.
p90.zh: 根据同一法规,小麦出口时的5s的旧赏金,在小麦出口时的价格上涨到44s时即告停止,而不是48s时即告停止;大麦出口时的价格上涨到22s时即告停止,而不是24s时即告停止;燕麦出口时的价格上涨到14s时即告停止,而不是15s时即告停止。 对黑麦的赏金从3:6d减少到3s。 一旦价格上涨到28s,它就停止了,而不是32s。 如果丰厚的财富像我努力证明的那样不适当,那么它们越早停止,越低,那么,它越好。

p91.original: The same statute permits, at the lowest prices, the importation of corn in order to be exported again, duty free, provided it is in the mean time lodged in a warehouse under the joint locks of the king and the importer. This liberty, indeed, extends to no more than twenty-five of the different ports of Great Britain. They are, however, the principal ones; and there may not, perhaps, be warehouses proper for this purpose in the greater part of the others.
p91.zh: 同样的法规允许以最低价格进口玉米,以便再次出口,免税,条件是在国王和进口商共同锁锁下的仓库中存放的这一平均时间。 这种自由确实扩展到大不列颠不同港口中的25个。 然而,它们是主要仓库;在大部分其他仓库中,也许没有适当的仓库。

p92.original: So far this law seems evidently an improvement upon the ancient system.
p92.zh: 迄今为止,这项法律似乎明显地改进了古代的制度。

p93.original: But by the same law, a bounty of 2s. the quarter is given for the exportation of oats, whenever the price does not exceed fourteen shillings. No bounty had ever been given before for the exportation of this grain, no more than for that of pease or beans.
p93.zh: 但根据同一法律,只要价格不超过14先令,则给予出口燕麦的四分之一赏金。 以前从未给予过任何赏金 用于出口这种谷物, 仅用于安抚或豆类。

p94.original: By the same law, too, the exportation of wheat is prohibited so soon as the price rises to forty-four shillings the quarter; that of rye so soon as it rises to twenty-eight shillings; that of barley so soon as it rises to twenty-two shillings; and that of oats so soon as they rise to fourteen shillings. Those several prices seem all of them a good deal too low; and there seems to be an impropriety, besides, in prohibiting exportation altogether at those precise prices at which that bounty, which was given in order to force it, is withdrawn. The bounty ought certainly either to have been withdrawn at a much lower price, or exportation ought to have been allowed at a much higher.
p94.zh: 同一法律也禁止小麦的出口,只要价格上涨到四十四先令,即为季度;黑麦的价格上涨到二十八先令,即为季麦;大麦的价格上涨到二十二先令,即为季麦;燕麦的价格上涨到十四先令,即为季麦。 这几种价格似乎都太低了;此外,完全禁止出口,其确切价格是用来强制出口的。赏金肯定不是以低得多的价格被撤回,就是应该允许以高得多的价格出口。

p95.original: So far, therefore, this law seems to be inferior to the ancient system. With all its imperfections, however, we may perhaps say of it what was said of the laws of Solon, that though not the best in itself, it is the best which the interest, prejudices, and temper of the times, would admit of. It may perhaps in due time prepare the way for a better.
p95.zh: 故至今此法似劣于古今制度. 然而,尽管它有种种不完善之处,我们也许可以说出所讲的索隆法律,虽然其本身不是最好的,但它是当时的利益、偏见和脾气所承认的最佳。 也许在适当的时候,它可以为更好的发展铺平道路。
